journey: Suspend abuse — the suspend control is operator-only; the durable-table enforcement is the gap

narrative.step: POSITIVE CONTROL — an un-suspended tenant passes admission (the gate is armed and ALLOWS)
narrative.assertion: un-suspended tenant admitted → 200 (fabric_suspended_tenants consulted, not blocking)

narrative.step: ATTACK — a tenant PAT cannot drive the operator suspend route (not a self-serve weapon)
narrative.assertion: tenant PAT → suspend route → 404 (NOT a 2xx — a tenant cannot suspend a tenant)

artifact.gap: The durable fabric_suspended_tenants admission cut-off (fabric-wide, N>1-safe, reversible by a table delete) is enforced against an operator-written pg row; CF-path enforcement is an ADR-0009 follow-up (built-not-proven).
artifact.reachableFrom: operator credential + pg table write — not the tenant /v1 API.
